description: This file defines the German (Austria) culture info for the Date.js library, including localized names, date formats, regex patterns, and prototype extensions related to date parsing and formatting.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date at midnight without time components.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
